name: Implement liquidity-pulse: TDD workflow (orchestration)
description:
Orchestration task for implementing liquidity-pulse in TDD order. Work through the 7 sub-tasks sequentially. For each:
  1. Write failing test(s) first
  2. Run make test — confirm test fails for the right reason
  3. Implement just enough code to pass
  4. Run make test + make lint — confirm clean
  5. Commit with message scoped to the task
  6. Stop and wait for user to say 'continue' before moving to next task

Sub-tasks in order:
  fpbxvybr — lp-1: Define Data and Classification types
  h24tofs7 — lp-2: Update Def() to declare both endpoints
  mh3k362q — lp-3: Parse CoinGecko response; compute ratio and classify
  fktw8ddj — lp-4: Cross-source validation against Binance BTC volume
  y6rrij8i — lp-5: Wire DetectStatus to set MetricResult.Status
  kg2ecgnr — lp-6: Assemble MetricResult with data and conditional meta
  vqbk3a38 — lp-7: E2E integration test for liquidity-pulse CLI command

Notes:
- Tasks lp-3 through lp-6 all modify Compute() in the same file. Between steps the function will be partially implemented — use placeholder returns so the file compiles between commits.
- lp-2 (Def endpoints) must come before lp-4 (Binance validation) since the data map only contains keys for declared endpoints.
- lp-7 test can be written before lp-6 is complete; it will fail until Compute() is fully wired.
- Source of truth for implementation: docs/metrics/liquidity-pulse.md, Design-Decisions.md Steps 12+14, CLAUDE.md Metric Conventions.
